description: The user's CallForMe balance, auto-reload setting, recent spend and projected run-out date, the "pause calls under" setting, their most recent call, and a link to add credit. Use it when the user asks about their balance, spend or settings, or before a large call_around to check the balance covers it; for what calls cost, use pricing (no account needed). Having no account yet is normal until the first real call. Auto-reload and the pause setting are changed by the user on the account page (the link it returns), not here.

account_key.description: Only for clients without OAuth: the cfm_ API key (from the account page or an earlier setup). Leave out when connected with OAuth.
